proposals.name: regex_tester
proposals.description: tool that checks whether a given text matches the candidate name pattern (Lula da Silva|Jair Bolsonaro) allowing for common typos, partials, and case variations, returning a pass/fail string.
proposals.code:
def tool(text):
    import re
    pattern = re.compile(r"\b(lula\s*da\s*s(?:i|l)a|jair\s*bolso\s*na?o)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
    return "MATCH" if pattern.search(text) else "NO MATCH"

TESTS = [
    ["Lula da Silva", "MATCH"],
    ["Jair Bolsonaro", "MATCH"],
    ["Lula da Sila", "MATCH"],
    ["Jair Bolsona", "MATCH"],
    ["Lu da Silva", "NO MATCH"],
    ["Bolsonaro", "MATCH"],
    ["Lula", "NO MATCH"]
]
